theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Start Investing Today With Just ₹500
body: Begin your investment journey with small amounts. Consistent contributions over time can build meaningful wealth through the power of compounding.
caption: Starting early gives your money more time to grow. Even small monthly investments can create significant long-term results when invested consistently. #YoungInvestor #SmallSteps #InvestEarly #CompoundingPower #WealthBuilding
